content: pty-process crate (preferred over portable-pty for tokio): pty_process::open() returns Pty+Pts. Pty implements AsyncRead+AsyncWrite. Use pty_process::Command::spawn(pts) to start child. Child is tokio::process::Child — use .wait().await to detect exit. Read stdout by reading from Pty; write stdin by writing to Pty. pty.resize() sets cols/rows. portable-pty is synchronous and requires a thread per pty reader; pty-process is the async-native choice for Tauri/tokio stacks.
